ideas.pitch: A reinforcement learning simulation sandbox implementing contextual bandits to optimize online matching under extreme information scarcity and delayed feedback.
ideas.problem_statement: How should a system make decisions with incomplete information and respond when feedback arrives over time?
ideas.title: BanditMatch: Contextual Multi-Armed Bandits for Dynamic Matching
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the core theoretical challenge directly using interpretable sequential decision-making algorithms rather than standard heuristics, aligning heavily with IIT Madras's applied ML focus.

ideas.pitch: An interactive dashboard that computes expected value of information (VoI) before making high-stakes matching decisions in simulated environments.
ideas.problem_statement: What information is worth acquiring and how should uncertainty be handled in sequential matching?
ideas.title: UncertaintyLens: Active Learning & Value-of-Information Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features a live interactive simulation and profiling dashboard that makes abstract sequential decision theory instantly transparent to judges.

ideas.pitch: A sequential matching agent equipped with real-time demographic parity and fairness constraints that dynamically adapt as the underlying population distribution shifts.
ideas.problem_statement: How can a system make decisions that remain effective and fair as conditions and feedback change over time?
ideas.title: FairMatch-Guard: Bias-Aware Sequential Allocation Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the societal and algorithmic fairness concerns inherent in automated recommendation systems and matching platforms.

ideas.pitch: A graph-based optimization engine that updates edge weights in real time based on stochastic, delayed feedback loops from previous match outcomes.
ideas.problem_statement: How should a system decide who should be introduced to whom when each decision changes the options and information available later?
ideas.title: GraphOptima: Dynamic Bipartite Matching with Delayed Edge Feedback
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard graph optimization and algorithmic rigor, separating the project from basic UI wrappers.

ideas.pitch: A configurable simulation environment and digital twin that spawns synthetic user pools with varying preferences to stress-test matching algorithms under non-stationary conditions.
ideas.problem_statement: Participants will work with a controlled environment using synthetic data, allowing them to experiment with these ideas without using real-world personal data.
ideas.title: SimState-Twin: Synthetic Environment Generator for Sequential Decision-Making
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides the foundational experimentation infrastructure that other teams lack, directly addressing the organizers' emphasis on controlled environments and synthetic data.
